en: Colorized postcard view of a large sanatorium-style building with red roofs and cream-colored walls, set on a hillside amid forests and fields. The multi‑storey structure has balconies and many windows, suggesting a health resort or convalescent home. The surrounding landscape is rural with trees, paths, and open meadows. At the top in red German text is the title identifying the place.
